content: Dhruv asked if there is a waiting period before the new policy becomes effective. Vikram explained there is a 30‑day waiting period but coverage will be backdated to the sign‑up date, so Dhruv can proceed now and will receive the new policy document by email and in his online account. Dhruv also asked whether his old policy still appears as expired.

action_items: Customer to sign up for the new policy
Agent to send the new policy document via email and make it downloadable in the online account
Agent to confirm the status of the old policy in the system
